_why: Every claim the pricing page makes, mapped to whether the thing exists. The FTC fined DoNotPay $193,000 for advertising a service it never tested. A page that offers a free trial of features nobody has written is the same failure with a different logo. check-features.mjs fails the build if a claim here is marked planned while the site presents it as buyable, so this file cannot quietly rot.
